title: ScamBuzzer
tagline: The AI Agent That Detects, Alerts, and Protects Crypto Users from Scams 🚨
description:
Problem: Over $2.3 billion was lost to crypto hacks and frauds in 2024, with phishing scams alone accounting for approximately $450 million. This widespread fraud has made many users hesitant to transact on-chain, reinforcing the perception that crypto is a scam-ridden industry.

However, knowledgeable and informed users not only safeguard their own assets but also contribute to the growth of blockchain innovation by preventing bad actors from damaging the industry’s reputation.

Solution: 
ScamBuzzer is a scam defense platform powered by an AI agent, built to detect, alert, and protect users from falling victim to scams.
how_its_made: ScamBuzzer is a platform designed to protect crypto users from phishing scams, malicious contracts, and impersonation attacks, leveraging a combination of blockchain technology and AI The frontend is built using Next.js. We used Privy for secure, user-friendly authentication. On the blockchain side, we developed and deployed an ERC-721 NFT smart contract on the Base and Arbitrum network. For ai agent we have used covalent ai agent sdk to build risk assessment tool.
